base_context_version.description: Context version this patch was written against, from get_context or collect_context_updates. A different current version is rejected as a Version Conflict.
base_context_version.title: Base Context Version

changes.description: Context sections to replace, keyed by section name: status, next_action, summary, unresolved_questions, invariants, architecture, source_document_refs, agent_results, workspace_changes. project_name and purpose are immutable.
changes.title: Changes

source_task_ids.description: Task ids whose reports justify this change (provenance).
source_task_ids.title: Source Task Ids

source_execution_ids.description: Execution ids whose reports justify this change. Their agent results are removed from the working Context on commit; the raw reports stay in the audit trail.
source_execution_ids.title: Source Execution Ids

source_document_refs.description: Evidence files as {path, sha256}; get the hash from get_source_reference.
source_document_refs.title: Source Document Refs

update_reason.description: Why the context changes, recorded in the version history.
update_reason.title: Update Reason

author_role.description: Always PM for callers; SYSTEM is reserved for ccc-mcp automation and is rejected.
author_role.title: Author Role

semantic_review_ack.description: Must be true for a PM patch: confirms the PM read the diff, because semantic equivalence cannot be proven. A patch without it is rejected.
semantic_review_ack.title: Semantic Review Ack
